subject: Create Johnny dashboard: Capture tab with real-time SSE stream
description:
Implement the Capture tab showing real-time observation stream via Server-Sent Events in Agent Hub.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/frontend-design` for UI/UX implementation, `/fastapi` for SSE endpoint, `/async-python-patterns` for streaming.

**Backend:**
- Create SSE endpoint GET /api/johnny/capture/stream
- Broadcast new observations as they're captured
- Include observation metadata in events
- Handle connection lifecycle

**Frontend:**
- Implement CaptureTab component
- Connect to SSE stream
- Display incoming observations in real-time
- Show observation type, content preview, source
- Auto-scroll to new items
- Connection status indicator
- Pause/resume stream toggle

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/capture_stream.py (new)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/api/johnny.py (SSE endpoint)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/tabs/CaptureTab.tsx
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/CaptureItem.tsx (new)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/hooks/use-johnny-stream.ts (new SSE hook)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] SSE endpoint streams new observations
- [ ] Capture tab connects to stream
- [ ] Real-time updates display
- [ ] Connection status shown
- [ ] Pause/resume toggle works
- [ ] Auto-scroll to new items
- [ ] Graceful disconnect handling
- [ ] `dt --check` passes
- [ ] `rebuild.sh` completed (in agent-hub)
- [ ] Verified in browser with live capture

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
